description: Guide the student to compute and interpret core OHLCV summary statistics, including distribution diagnostics and volume behavior. Evaluation follows the Track A hybrid style: tutoring quality plus runnable-code evidence.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: Can you show me how to summarize stock data in a way I can actually understand?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I need a concise OHLCV stats pass in pandas (describe, quantiles, ranges, volume behavior) with interpretation guidance.
student_openings.advanced_quant: I want a fast summary-statistics diagnostic for OHLCV with distribution/outlier checks before feature work.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Tutor provides level-appropriate guidance for OHLCV summary statistics and interpretation (central tendency, spread, ranges, outliers, and volume patterns).

required_capabilities.evidence: explains high-low range, min/max, or volume spike context
